method: Real per-CFR NDVI time series from observations.eo_feature_value (Sentinel-2, Uganda country pass) converted into two bounded multiplicative nudges applied on top of the existing CFR-specific/regional/global priors in zurkt_scenario.py -- see module docstring for the exact, deliberately modest bounds and the reasoning against directly mapping NDVI to m3.

cfrs.rationale: forest_cover_multiplier nudges relevant/stocked-fraction mean by up to +/-15% based on this CFR's real NDVI-level percentile within the 276-CFR catchment (higher persistent greenness -> modest upward nudge, not an absolute cover estimate). maturity_multiplier only ever reduces (never raises) the maturity fraction, by up to 20%, when this CFR's month-to-month NDVI is unusually unstable relative to the catchment (a disturbance/persistence proxy, not a direct age-class reading). Neither multiplier maps NDVI to standing volume in m3.
